$comment: Catalog of languages for Learn-Luganda packs. Not loaded by the app: it plans which UI packs (src/packs/ui/<code>.json) and course packs (src/packs/courses/<from>-<to>/) to build, in which order. speakersMillions is a rough L1+L2 estimate (Ethnologue/census-era figures, rounded) for ordering only. wave: 0 = built, 1 Uganda, 2 East Africa and the Horn, 3 West Africa, 4 Central and Southern Africa, 5 North Africa, 6 global languages, 7 later/community-led (small, liturgical or endangered). draftConfidence: how well Claude can draft the language without a native speaker (all drafts still need native review). See docs/languages/README.md.
